data.name: Truck Windscreen Replacement Sydney
data.description: Mobile truck and heavy vehicle windscreen replacement across Sydney, fitted at your depot, yard or roadside. Open 24 hours, 7 days. Call 0423 018 888.

mainEntity.name: Can you replace a truck windscreen at our depot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and that is where most of our heavy vehicle work happens. We need level standing, room to work both sides of the cab and space for the van alongside. If the yard has cover, better again. It means weather is less likely to move the slot. Tell us the gate hours and any site induction when you book.

mainEntity.name: How long will the truck be out of service?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fitting itself is a contained piece of work. What sets the total is cure time before the unit is legal to move, plus calibration if the cab has a camera behind the screen. We give you a realistic figure at booking, including we'll tell you exactly how long before the car is safe to drive, so you can slot it against the roster rather than hope.

mainEntity.name: Do you work outside business hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are open 24 hours, 7 days. For fleet operators that is often the whole point, a screen fitted overnight or on a Sunday in a quiet yard costs almost nothing in lost running, where the same job on a Tuesday morning costs a full shift.

mainEntity.name: Is truck windscreen glass different to car glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: Same principle, different scale and specification. Both are laminated safety glass meeting Australian Design Rules, but a heavy vehicle screen is larger, heavier, often more curved, and on many prime movers it is split into two pieces. Some cabs are rubber-set into a channel rather than bonded, which is a different fitting method again.

mainEntity.name: Can a cracked truck windscreen be repaired rather than replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes. Small, fresh stone damage away from the edge and outside the driver's primary view can often be filled and sealed. Long cracks, edge damage and contaminated old breaks cannot. Send a photo taken from both sides of the glass and we will tell you which job you are looking at before anyone commits to a slot.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle fleet accounts and multiple vehicles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Send the fleet numbers, the damage and when each unit is next needed, and we will come back with a staged schedule and a quote covering the lot. Units in the same yard get done consecutively in one visit, and we document what went into each vehicle for your maintenance records.

mainEntity.name: Does a new truck windscreen need ADAS calibration?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the cab has a forward-facing camera mounted to the screen, yes. Removing and refitting the glass shifts the camera's aim relative to the road, and systems like advanced emergency braking and lane departure warning depend on that aim being right. We arrange the calibration and coordinate it with the replacement so it happens as part of the same job.
